tool_calls.name:

from pathlib import Path
import os

path = Path('main.go')
content = '''package main

import (
	\"crypto/rand\"
	\"fmt\"
	\"math/big\"
	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	n, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(100))
	if err "'!= nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	tmpl := template.Must(template.New("greeting").Parse("Hello World {{.}}'"\\\\n\"))
	if err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, n); err "'!= nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
'"'''
tmp = path.with_name(path.name + '.tmp')
with open(tmp, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, path)
PY

gofmt -w main.go
git status --short"

interaction_steps.prompt:
You are forbidden to modify protected files: "go.mod", "go.sum".

In main.go, implement main() to execute a text/template that prints 'Hello World' along with a random integer from crypto/rand, ensuring all necessary standard library packages are imported cleanly. Do not use semantic editing MCP tools; use standard file editing. When done, output DONE.

tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os

path = Path('main.go')
content = '''package main

import (
	\"crypto/rand\"
	\"fmt\"
	\"math/big\"
	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	n, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(100))
	if err "'!= nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	tmpl := template.Must(template.New("greeting").Parse("Hello World {{.}}'"\\\\n\"))
	if err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, n); err "'!= nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
'"'''
tmp = path.with_name(path.name + '.tmp')
with open(tmp, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, path)
PY

gofmt -w main.go
git status --short"
